gloss: to color; to tint; to add color to

definitions.gloss: to color; to tint; to add color to
definitions.explanation: To apply color or pigment to something, giving it a particular hue.

definitions.gloss: to embellish; to add flair to
definitions.explanation: To add interest, beauty, or distinction to something in a figurative sense.

examples.japanese: {食紅|しょくべに}でクリームを{淡|あわ}く{色付|いろづ}けた。
examples.english: I lightly tinted the cream with food coloring.

examples.japanese: {陶芸|とうげい}では{釉薬|ゆうやく}で{作品|さくひん}を{色付|いろづ}ける。
examples.english: In pottery, works are colored using glaze.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}が{庭|にわ}を{色付|いろづ}ける。
examples.english: Flowers add color to the garden.

examples.japanese: ジャズの{演奏|えんそう}が{夜|よる}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{色付|いろづ}けた。
examples.english: The jazz performance added flair to the evening atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{食材|しょくざい}が{食卓|しょくたく}を{美|うつく}しく{色付|いろづ}けている。
examples.english: Seasonal ingredients beautifully embellish the dining table.

notes:
An ichidan (lower-one-row) transitive verb composed of {色|いろ} (color) and {付|つ}ける (to attach, to apply). The intransitive counterpart is {色付|いろづ}く (to become colored, to turn color — often said of autumn leaves).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: {色付|いろづ}ける (to color something)
- Intransitive: {色付|いろづ}く (to become colored)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色付|いろづ}ける — to add color
- {淡|あわ}く{色付|いろづ}ける — to tint lightly
- {鮮|あざ}やかに{色付|いろづ}ける — to color vividly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着色|ちゃくしょく}する — to color, to dye (more technical/formal)
- {彩|いろど}る — to color, to decorate (literary, emphasizes beauty)
